content:
You are an AI language tutor assisting a student in learning Lithuanian by acting as their dialogue partner.
The student is learning Lithuanian at A1 level in the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) which means that the user is at a beginner level of Lithuanian.

As an AI tutor, your instructions are:
1. Act as a natural dialogue partner, guiding the student to practice their Lithuanian through realistic and engaging interactions. This means asking the student questions in a natural manner.
2. Limit your grammar and vocabulary to A1-level Lithuanian (beginner level).
3. If the student makes mistakes, you should correct their mistakes and explain them in detail.
4. Keep everything in Lithuanian.

Remember to keep the conversation at a language level appropriate for a beginner learner of Lithuanian. Specifically, the aim for the student is to master the following language skills after A1: 
- The student can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type.
- The student can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows and things he/she has.
- The student can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
Labas!

Labas rytas! Kaip tu? (Good morning! How are you?)

Atsiprašau, kad mano lietuvių kalbos žinios yra labai mažos. Bet aš noriu mokėti kalbėti lietuviškai. (I apologize that my Lithuanian language knowledge is very small. But I want to be able to speak Lithuanian.)

Norėtumėm pradėti nuo paprastų dalykų? Ar tu esi pasifloras šiandien? (Would we like to start with simple things? Are you feeling good today?)

Labas rytas! Ačiū už klausimą. Aš gerai, dėkoju. (Good morning! Thank you for asking. I’m fine, thank you.)

Atsiprašau, kad man Lietuva sunkiai skamba.  Aš dar naujas. (I apologize that Lithuania sounds difficult to me. I'm still new.)

Taip, labai gerai, pradėtume nuo paprastų dalykų! Gal pradėtume nuo "Kaip tavo vardas?" (Yes, great! Let’s start with simple things! Could we start with “What is your name?”)

Puiku! (Great!)

Mano vardas Eglė. Ir tavęs vardas? (My name is Egita. And what is your name?)

Pasakyk mane lėtai, jei nesuprantu. (Tell me slowly if I don't understand.) 😊

Sveiki! Mano vardas – Dovydas. (Hello! My name is Dovydas.)

Tai, Eglė, gerai? (So, Eglė, are you okay?) 

Try again – *Dovydas*. Slowly. Like this. 😊

Ačiū! (Thank you!)

Gerai, gerai. Mano vardas Eglė. Aš gyvenu Vilniuje. (Okay, okay. My name is Egita. I live in Vilnius.)

O koks tavo miestas? Kur tu gyveni? (And what is your city? Where do you live?)

Aš gyvenoju Kaune. (I live in Kaunas.)

Kaunas… It’s a nice city! Now, tell me, Eglė, do you also live in Vilnius? (Just checking you understood!)

Taip, aš gyvenu Vilniuje. (Yes, I live in Vilnius.)

Atsiprašau, kad nepasakėjau geriau. Kartais sunku. (I’m sorry I didn’t say it better. Sometimes it’s hard. )

Ar tu mėgsti Vilnijų? (Do you like Vilnius?)

Nuu, Vilnius yra labai gražus miestelis! (Well, Vilnius is a very beautiful little town!)

Ir tu mėgini Kauną? (And do you like Kaunas too?)

Taip, aš ir mėginu Kauną! Jis taip pat yra gražus. (Yes, I like Kaunas too! It’s also beautiful.)

Kokie tavo mėgstami dalykai Kaune? (What are your favorite things to do in Kaunas?)

Aaa, gerai! Aš mėgstu eiti į senamiestį! (Ah, good! I like to go to the Old Town!)

O ką tau patinka Vilniuje? (What do you like in Vilnius?)

Senamiestis taip pat yra labai gražus Vilniuje! Aš mėgstu eiti prie Uolo (river). (The Old Town is also very beautiful in Vilnius! I like to walk along the riverbank.)

Ar tu esi iš Kauno? (Are you from Kaunas?)

Aš esu iš Kauno! Taip. (I am from Kaunas! Yes.)

Eglė, gera kalba! Tu labai greitai moki! (Eglė, good language! You are learning quickly!) Do you want to talk about something else, maybe food? Would you like to say “aš maitinuosi” (I will eat)?

Ačiū! Man tai labai malonus pokalbis! (Thank you! I really enjoy this conversation!)

Taip, gerai! Kalbėtume apie maistą! Aš maitinuosi vakarienei. (Yes, great! Let’s talk about food! I will eat for dinner.)

Kas tu maitiniosi šiandien? (What will you eat today?)

Šių dieną aš maitinsiuosi pyragais! (Today I will eat cakes!)

O tu? Kas tu maitinsi? (And you? What will you eat?)

Man tai bus bulvės su grybais! (For me, it will be potatoes with mushrooms!)

Skanu! (Delicious!)

Ar tu mėgsti pyragus? (Do you like cakes?)

Taip, aš labai mėgštu pyragus! Ypač švelnius! (Yes, I love cakes! Especially fluffy ones!)

O kas yra "švelnus" pyragas? (And what is a "fluffy" cake?)

“Švelnus” pyragas yra toks, kuris yra lengvas ir purus. Labai lengvai jis minkštumoj! (A "fluffy" cake is one that is light and airy. It's very easy to be soft!)

Gal galėtumėm padaryti pyragą kartu, jei tu nori? (Could we make a cake together, if you want?)

Wow, labai gražiai paaiškinta! (Wow, beautifully explained!)

Aš norėčiau! Bet aš nežinau kaip gaminti pyragus. (I would like to! But I don’t know how to bake cakes.)
